rules: object keys sorted by Unicode code point
decimal numbers carried as non-exponent strings and trailing zero normalized according to field scale
digest excludes only the field explicitly named selfDigest

invariants: Historical Shipment and Delivery facts are immutable; normal return creates separate facts.
Original Demand is never automatically reopened by return, credit, refund or replacement.
Application and AuthorizationDecision are separate immutable version streams.
Authorized quantity, physically received quantity, quality partition, disposition effect, commercial decision and financial result are separate axes.

Within one effective quality scope ACCEPTED, REJECTED, HOLD and PENDING are pairwise disjoint and their union equals the effective scope; VOID is excluded source-correction range, not a fifth quality state.
Every receipt and disposition range has one canonical base-coordinate mapping and cannot be applied twice.
Unknown, not observed, pending and failed are not success and do not authorize a new business key.
Commercial or financial failure never rolls back a confirmed physical fact; physical completion never fabricates commercial or financial completion.
Replacement or supplementary shipment creates a new demand/order lineage and only links to the RMA.
A correction appends a successor fact and link; it never overwrites or deletes its predecessor.

x-cp6-invariants: activeClaimQty is measure of the occupied claim union A
authorizedQty equals occupied claim quantity for the proven cut; receivedQty and creditedQty are subset/independent axes and are not added to authorizedQty
remainingAuthorizableQty = measure(eligible union E) - measure(occupied union A)
requestedRanges are pairwise disjoint and within originalSnapshot.sourceShareRanges
requestedQuantity.value equals exact measure(requestedRanges) in originalSnapshot.baseQty.uom
sourceCutRef/sourceVersionRef are mandatory eligibility evidence and CAS inputs, but a new source version cannot create another coordinate or bypass occupied claims
claimRanges nonempty, pairwise disjoint and subset of coordinate.eligibleRanges
claimedQuantity equals exact measure(claimRanges) in coordinate.baseUom
occupied states are ACTIVE_RESERVED, CONSUMED_BY_RECEIPT, UNKNOWN_HOLD
may be created only in the same Uow as an APPROVED AuthorizationDecision
ranges and quantity byte-semantically equal the referenced ReturnRangeClaim
partitions contain each of ACCEPTED, REJECTED, HOLD, PENDING exactly once
partition ranges are pairwise disjoint and their union equals effective scope after subtracting voidRanges
voidRanges are source-correction exclusions, not a quality state

DispositionSliceInput.x-cp6-trust-rule: browser selects only server-signed proposal/selection/options and exact ranges; sliceId/effectKey/state/quality/quantity/receipts are server-derived

x-cp6-invariants: HOLD/PENDING proposals have allowedDispositions=[] and may offer only RMA-C09H hold reason options
terminal options are current-policy server-signed and revalidated on apply
sliceId/effectKey/quantity/quality/adapter/state/receipt refs are server-derived from the signed proposal and current facts; no public input supplies them
in current R3 all five terminal branches remain REQUIRED_FENCED with ownerWorkRef/ownerResultRef/stockReceiptRef/applicationReceiptRef null because no exact accepted Effect Owner contract exists
APPLIED is retained for accurate historical/future successor reads only and requires an exact accepted Owner result plus Stock receipt under that separate contract

ContinueHoldRequest.x-cp6-invariant: local no-effect annotation only; it creates no terminal DispositionSlice, does not consume a disposition range and cannot prevent a later professional resolution

x-cp6-invariants: net + tax = gross in the same currency
quantity equals exact measure of coveredRanges
coveredRanges are within covered claims and do not overlap another quantity-bearing component

x-cp6-combination-rules: RETURN_ONLY and REJECTED are exclusive singleton bundles
CREDIT may combine with REFUND_AUTHORIZATION only when refund.creditComponentRef names that CREDIT component
CREDIT, REPLACEMENT and SUPPLEMENTARY_SHIPMENT may coexist only on disjoint covered claim ranges
REFUND_AUTHORIZATION consumes no additional return quantity and authorizedAmount cannot exceed its referenced CREDIT gross
all quantity-bearing components form a disjoint subset of the approved commercial scope; correction uses previousOutcomeRef and new resultVersion

SealedNoEffectTerminalReceipt.x-cp6-invariant: canInferNoEffect may be true only when this authorized proof-bearing receipt is present

x-cp6-invariants: quantity equals measure(receiptRanges)
request creates/links an inspection obligation only; it never supplies a professional decision
eligibleQuantity equals measure(eligibleRanges)
request does not contain approved amount, tax, currency or approval identity; those are Owner results
baselineRef must be non-null iff baselineKnowledge is KNOWN
no quantity/sourceLine requirement; this is H47 source-fact feedback
no manifestDigest member exists on the accepted wire
parts and PostingData lines are a bidirectional one-to-one set by clientLineKey
Manifest parent, request source and every part/line source are exact

StockPostingData.x-cp6-source: complete accepted WMS-STOCK-01 §4.2 PostingData mirror; no projection alias

x-cp6-invariants: source equals manifest.parent
data.kind/use.action/manifest postingKind/requestedAction obey the exact accepted matrix
all posting lines and manifest parts match bidirectionally
RMA-only claim/range/conversion/digest evidence stays here and is never added to STK-SOURCE-EXECUTION-1
RETURN_ORIGINAL_ROOT maps to PostingData RETURN and RequestedUse RETURN
RECEIPT_NEW_SOURCE maps to PostingData RECEIPT and RequestedUse RECEIVE

RmaInboundPrepareRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: service-only WMS-IN adapter rereads immutable receipt/share/claim facts, derives route, accepted Stock wire and all digests; browser supplies none of them

ApplyInboundReceiptRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: trusted WMS-IN adapter supplies the complete typed result; ordinary browser cannot submit this DTO

RmaDispositionAdapterBinding.x-cp6-boundary: five unique target projections; no effect Owner is assigned and no Owner call is legal until an exact accepted contract exists

RmaDispositionPrepareRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: service-only adapter rereads the server-derived slices and proposal/options; no public field can supply adapterId, Stock kind/action, effect key, quality truth, FrozenIntent or receipt

RmaDispositionPreparation.x-cp6-invariant: current fixed scope contains no accepted disposition effect Owner contract; preparation never creates a Stock manifest, plan, FrozenIntent, locator or quantity effect

RmaDispositionCommitRequest.x-cp6-invariant: current R3 owner gate always returns DISPOSITION_ADAPTER_REQUIRED_FENCED before any Owner or Stock call

RmaDispositionSealRequest.x-cp6-invariant: a REQUIRED_FENCED target cannot be sealed as no-effect; no Owner seal route exists in the current contract

RmaDispositionAdapterResult.x-cp6-invariant: this is a local qualification result, not an external Owner result and never authorizes APPLIED

RmaDispositionAdapterOutcome.x-cp6-boundary: closed current-state outcome; future executable Owner contracts require a successor spec and cannot reuse this result as success

ApplyDispositionAdapterResultRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: service records only the local REQUIRED_FENCED qualification observation; no browser or service can submit an Owner/Stock success through this DTO

x-cp6-invariants: quantity equals measure(receivedRanges)
receivedRanges subset the occupied rangeClaim and the WMS-IN/Stock sourceRangeMap
this receipt proves physical return only, never resale eligibility, credit amount or financial posting
guard is a bounded read; final consumer claim rechecks the same coordinate head under lock
requestedQuantity equals measure(requestedRanges)
FIN-AR RETURN_CREDIT_SOURCE requires exact commercial Owner result and, when policy requires, exact QA result
FIN-INV RETURN_VALUE_SOURCE requires physical result and exact valuation/quality basis but commercial result may be null
ranges subset physical receipt and guard; quantity equals range measure
APPLIED requires applicationReceiptRef
RECEIVED is not APPLIED; UNKNOWN retains H30ConsumerUseClaim

SubmitRmaApplicationRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: server rereads the immutable application version and computes bodyDigest; browser never supplies a trusted digest

x-cp6-invariants: ranges subset the referenced RequestedReturnLineSnapshot and entitlement eligible set
quantity equals exact range measure
ranges nonempty subset of the occupied ReturnRangeClaim and not already received
quantity equals exact range measure

ApplyDispositionSlicesRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: server resolves signed proposal/options and derives slice/effect/adapter/quality/quantity/receipt fields; public input never carries system result state

RmaDispositionApplyResult.x-cp6-invariant: all slices remain REQUIRED_FENCED; no APPLIED transition and no Stock or external Owner result

OriginalFulfilmentOption.x-cp6-trust-rule: optionRef is a server-signed immutable selection reference, not an authorization or trusted digest supplied by the browser

EvidenceOpenRequest.x-cp6-trust-rule: server resolves its signed evidenceOptionRef to the exact owner/id/version/digest; browser cannot nominate arbitrary Owner URL or artifact identity

x-cp6-invariants: READY is not a bearer grant; content route rechecks current object visibility, capability and field policy before bytes
EXPIRED or REVOKED has null contentRoute/contentDigest and returns zero bytes

BinaryContentDescriptor.x-cp6-invariant: descriptor accompanies the authorized byte stream; any failed recheck returns Problem and zero bytes, never this descriptor alone as success
